summary: Frontend testing of Share with Clients modal improvements - Search functionality and Email options. All 7 requested features tested and working correctly.
passed_tests: Search input has correct placeholder: 'Search by name, email, phone or PAN...'
Search filters client list in real-time as user types
Search works for name filtering (typed 'NRI' - showed all 3 NRI clients)
Search works for email filtering (typed 'testnri2' - showed only Test NRI Client 2)
Send via Email toggle is ON by default (checked: true)
Include Property Photos checkbox is visible when email toggle is on
Include Property Photos checkbox is checked by default
Include Property Photos checkbox hides when email toggle is turned off
Submit button shows 'Share & Email X Client(s)' when email toggle is ON
Submit button shows 'Share with X Client(s)' when email toggle is OFF
Client list items show email icon (Mail icon) for clients with email addresses
Select All button works - selects all filtered clients
Select All button changes to 'Deselect All' when all clients are selected
Filtered count shows 'Showing X of Y' when search is active
critical_code_review_comments: ShareWithClientsModal component (lines 2884-3157) properly implements all requested features
Search filtering uses useMemo for performance optimization (lines 2895-2904)
Email toggle state (sendEmail) defaults to true as required (line 2889)
Include photos toggle (includePhotos) defaults to true (line 2890)
Backend share-email endpoint (line 15420) properly handles include_photos parameter
Email service send_real_estate_opportunity_email function (line 630) includes photos in email when enabled
data-testid attributes properly added for all interactive elements
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - 3 test clients (Test NRI Client, Test NRI Client 2, Test NRI Client 3) with emails
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share with Clients modal has been enhanced with: 1) Search input (data-testid='client-search-input') that filters by name/email/phone/PAN, 2) Send via Email toggle (data-testid='send-email-toggle') ON by default, 3) Include Property Photos toggle (data-testid='include-photos-toggle') visible when email is on, 4) Submit button (data-testid='submit-share-btn') text changes based on email toggle state. Property tested: The Autograph - S Series (ID: 88a2aea2-1ff9-4e34-aa8f-16486e854d6c). Backend endpoints: POST /api/real-estate-opportunities/{id}/share and POST /api/real-estate-opportunities/{id}/share-email
